topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I can't abide cheats, the kind who steal the sweat of someone else's brow and call it their own. The lad they say copied words, he’s been lounging around, thinking himself too good for the honest toil of the mind. If it's true, let the laws of the village and the wrath of Saint Nicholas fall heavy on him. He should know better, everyone does, living here where we plant and reap the fruits of our labor. There’s no place for such deceit in these parts. The earth is unforgiving, and the truth grows better than lies. If he won’t learn now, when will he? This is no light matter, not in my book.
